title: from_h5mu_to_seurat
description:
Converts an h5mu file into a Seurat file.

Restrictions:
  - Only the intersection of cells is currently loaded into the Seurat object due to the object structure limitation.
  - Multimodal embeddings (global .obsm slot) are loaded with the assay.used field set to the default assay.
  - Embeddings names are changed in order to comply with R & Seurat requirements and conventions.
  - Feature names with underscores ('_') are automatically replaced with dashes ('-')
  - Seurat does not support global variables metadata /var.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.h5mu`

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output.rds`

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
